events.title: e-gold launches as an early digital value system

research.summary: Gold & Silver Reserve began offering e-gold in 1996 as an internet digital currency backed by precious metals.
research.significance: e-gold demonstrated that internet-native private money could reach significant real-world use years before Bitcoin, while remaining dependent on a centralized issuer and legal infrastructure.
